summary: Bind raw PEEK capabilities to authorization epochs and restrict pairing revocation to its issuer

schema.detail: Adds an index for pairing-completed session_actor lookup; no schema version or data migration changes.

rules.detail: RULES_VERSION remains11; no checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: PEEK admission is issuer-gateway-bound and rejects an acquisition whose authority epoch changed. A non-issuer pairing revoke returns issuer-required instead of committing.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption beyond a normal daemon upgrade.

manual.detail: Revoke pairings at their issuing gateway; a non-issuer refusal identifies issuer_host_id. This is an intermediate lease-stack behavior, not the authenticated PEEK cutover.

recovery.detail: No data rewrite or destructive migration; existing binary swap-back behavior is unchanged. Older builds retain their older observation enforcement.
